detailed_description: Image Border adds a uniform colored frame around one image in the browser. Pick an image file, drag the border width slider between 0 and 100 pixels, and choose a color from eight preset swatches, the color picker, or the hex text input. The tool draws on a canvas the same width as the original plus twice the border on each side, fills the canvas with the border color, draws the image centered, and shows the original and new dimensions. Click Download to save the framed image as a PNG. The tool applies the same width on all four sides only and does not support per-side padding, rounded corners, gradient or pattern fills, drop shadows, or formats other than PNG output.
usage_steps: Click Upload Image and pick a raster image file
Drag the border width slider between 0 and 100 pixels
Pick a preset swatch, use the color picker, or type a hex code in the text box
Watch the canvas redraw the image with the new uniform border
Read the original and new dimensions shown below the preview
Click Download to save the framed image as a PNG
usage_examples: Frame a photo with a 10-pixel white border before sharing it on social media
Add a thick black border to a screenshot to highlight it inside a slide deck
Pick a brand color from the hex input and add a thin frame to a product image
Compare the original and new dimensions to plan the layout space the framed image will need
